issue.title: Persist the Bob Mac Capture retained live draft across restarts
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Persist the Bob Mac Capture retained live draft so Escape / failed-capture text survives Quit, Restart, crash, and logout.

After https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/pull/1, Control-C canceled drafts write through to `~/Library/Application Support/org.bobs.bob-mac-capture/canceled-draft-stash.json`. The in-editor live draft does not. `CapturePanelModel` still keeps it only in memory (`attributedDraft` / `plainDraft`, plus presentation state such as `errorMessage` and `statusText`). `prepareForRetainedClose()` / `closeRetainingDraft()` set `"Draft retained"` and dismiss the panel; `prepareForPresentation()` reopens that in-memory draft on the next hotkey. `AppDelegate` constructs a fresh `CapturePanelModel` on every launch, so the retained draft is gone after any process exit.

This is a different store from the canceled-draft stash: one current draft (not a bounded newest-first list), restored automatically on next panel open rather than through Control-S, and discarded by **Discard** / Control-C / successful capture rather than by Clear Stash. The approved persist-stash plan named this as out of scope and asked for a follow-up task bead rather than folding it into that PR.

### Evidence

- `Sources/BobMacCapture/CapturePanelModel.swift` — `prepareForRetainedClose()`, `closeRetainingDraft()`, `prepareForPresentation()`, and `discardDraft()` operate only on in-memory published state. There is no encode, decode, or file I/O.
- Tests `testEscapeClosesOnceAndRetainsNonemptyDraft` and `testEscapeDismissesCompletionBeforeClosingPanel` assert in-process retention only.
- PR-branch README Privacy still says captured text lives only in the panel's in-memory draft (plus the new on-disk stash for Control-C). A live-draft persist would be a second documented-guarantee change, same class of README/Settings rewrite the stash work required.

### Suggested shape (not a plan)

Mirror the stash store: Foundation-only CaptureCore JSON file under the same 0700 Application Support directory, write-through on retain/discard/success, delete the file when the live draft is empty, metadata-only errors, never interpolate draft text. Do not persist completion candidates, preview payloads, or diagnostics that are not needed to reopen the editor exactly as left. Confirm with the owner whether a failed capture's `errorMessage` should survive relaunch.

Work is in the `bob-mac-capture` linked repo. Linux can type-check CaptureCore only; macOS CI is the real gate.

Plan that scoped this out: `plan:202608/persist_canceled_draft_stash.md`.

task_type_fields.proposal: Persist the Bob Mac Capture in-editor retained live draft (Escape / failed capture) across Quit, Restart, crash, and logout. This is a single-draft store restored on the next panel open, not the Control-C canceled-draft stash.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved persist-canceled-draft-stash plan (and PR bobs-org/bob-mac-capture#1) explicitly left this out: it is a different store with different semantics (one current draft, not a bounded list; auto-restore on panel open, not Control-S). The user asked about the stash. Do not fold this into that PR.

payload.entry: RELATED: bob-cli-q — drag-and-drop paste also edits CapturePanelModel / the capture editor; a live-draft persist that writes on every text change could collide with that change if both land together.
RELATED: bob-cli-r — large-paste policy also lives on the capture editor draft path; persist-on-every-keystroke vs persist-on-retain would interact with any size ceiling that bead adds.

CONTEXT: persist-canceled-draft-stash shipped in https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/pull/1 (3bb1691); CI run 32262048348 is green. That PR persists Control-C stash only. This bead is the live-draft follow-up the plan scoped out.

payload.close_reason: I'm pretty sure we already did this.
